# trino_schemas Data Source

Lists the schemas in a Trino catalog.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "trino_schemas" "example" {
  catalog = "hive"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog` (String) Catalog whose schemas should be listed.

### Read-Only

- `schemas` (List of String) Schemas in the catalog, sorted by name.
